svg.title: The generic process theorem specializes to a cocycle upper envelope
svg.desc: A vertical ladder begins with an integrable shifted-subadditive process whose normalized paths are eventually bounded below almost everywhere, obtains one fixed positive-block upper limsup cap, enters the nonnegative compatibility wrapper for the log-positive cocycle process, intersects the countable full-measure block events, and takes the deterministic infimum to reach the cocycle upper envelope. The output is not a signed Lyapunov exponent.
svg.text: From a generic process to a cocycle upper envelope
The specialization preserves every one-sided boundary.
Normalized paths eventually lower-bounded almost everywhere.
The generic statement holds on a full-measure event.
The cocycle process uses lower bound zero.
All block caps hold at the same sample points.
The upper envelope reaches the integrated Fekete rate.
Not a signed Lyapunov exponent, convergence theorem, or invariant splitting.
